summary: Wave 107 — Customer Dashboard bug fix (₹296→₹349 total) + full redesign. Both bug fix and redesign VERIFIED end-to-end via seeded buyer + 2 mock orders on the live preview. paidTotal formula (total+gst+delivery) renders correctly. All 6 required data-testids present per card. Status labels, timestamp format, structured address composition, dealer display, conditional tracking row, and dynamic 'incl. GST [+ delivery]' subtitle all work as specified. Mobile 375px viewport has zero horizontal overflow. Backend /orders/mine returns the required raw shape. Test data seeded + cleaned up. NOTE: Discovered a pre-existing (NOT Wave 107) critical bug — PUT /orders/{id}/status with status='completed' returns 500 due to a Postgres check constraint `orders_status_check` that omits 'completed'. The Confirm-received button in the UI will fail. Zero 'completed' orders exist in DB, confirming this has never worked.

critical.issue: Returns 500 when status='completed'. DB check constraint orders_status_check does not include 'completed'. Buyer 'Confirm you received your order' button (delivered→completed transition) always fails. 0 completed rows currently in DB. Fix: ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT orders_status_check; ADD CONSTRAINT with completed included.

integration_issues.issue: Downstream 500 from DB constraint (see backend critical). Frontend code is correct; DB schema needs fixing.

issues: en-IN locale renders 'am/pm' lowercase (e.g. '04:15 pm') whereas spec requested 'AM/PM' uppercase. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Fix DB check constraint `orders_status_check` on public.orders to include 'completed' (and any other statuses used by the app). Otherwise buyer confirm-received will always 500.
(Optional cosmetic) Force uppercase AM/PM in formatOrderTime — e.g. .replace(' am',' AM').replace(' pm',' PM') — spec asked for uppercase.
critical_code_review_comments: paidTotal helper is correct and mirrors the checkout math — good.
formatAddress fallback to delivery_address is present — safe against legacy rows.
Tracking row correctly gated on status ∈ {shipped, delivered, completed} AND (courier || tracking).
The DB status check constraint mismatch is a schema/code drift — worth adding a startup guard that validates DB allowed-status list against the app's `allowed` set.

rca of the issue: Original bug (Wave 107 target): CustomerDashboard was rendering `o.total` which is the pre-GST base (₹296) instead of the checkout-locked grand total (base+gst+delivery=₹349). Fix confirmed: paidTotal(o) helper at line 45 sums base+gst+delivery and is bound to data-testid=order-total-paid-<id> at line 283. Live test with total=296, gst_amount=53, delivery_charge=0 renders '₹349' as required.
